```yaml
name: Bump personal server after release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  bump-personal-server:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout personal server repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: scidsg/hushline-personal-server
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          ref: main

      - name: Configure git
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Set NEW_VERSION environment variable
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          VERSION=${TAG#v}
          echo "NEW_VERSION=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Create bump branch
        run: git checkout -b bump-${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}

      - name: Update DEBIAN/control
        run: |
          sed -i "s/^Version:.*/Version: ${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}/" DEBIAN/control

      - name: Update docker-compose.yaml
        run: |
          sed -i "s|image:.*|image: scidsg/hushline-personal-server:${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}|" var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git add DEBIAN/control var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml
          git commit -m "Bump version to ${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}"

      - name: Push bump branch
        run: git push origin bump-${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}

      - name: Install gh CLI
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y gh

      - name: Authenticate gh
        run: echo "${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}" | gh auth login --with-token

      - name: Create pull request
        run: |
          gh pr create \
            --title "Bump version to ${{ env.NEW_VERSION }}" \
            --body "Automated bump after release" \
            --head bump-${{ env.NEW_VERSION }} \
            --base main

      - name: Merge pull request
        run: |
          gh pr merge --auto --squash --delete-branch
```
